medSchoolStudLife.leaveOfAbsence: Applications for a leave of absence are considered on a case-by-case basis for medical or personal reasons.  LOA status is granted for one year at a time with the possibility for a second year's renewal if the application is resubmitted before the first year of leave ends. Students who do not return to full-time status at the end of the leave and who have not reapplied for renewal of the leave are considered to have withdrawn from Harvard Medical School and need to reapply to HMS through the Council of Student Affairs, if they wish to return at some future date.

medSchoolStudLife.housing: On-campus housing for students is available in Vanderbilt Hall, or students are eligible to live in other nearby Harvard University Housing.  Alternatively, students may choose to live in one of the residential communities neighboring the Longwood Medical Area.

medSchoolStudLife.campusCulture:
Harvard Medical School brings together extraordinarily talented individuals from a wide variety of experiences and backgrounds, who share the drive and ambition to be leaders in science, medicine, and health.

Our students thrive in a culture of support and an abundance of resources to nurture their talent. Many are inspired by our institution’s long history of innovation, transforming potential into achievements that have made a difference in the world. Our commitment to the intellectual and professional growth of every member of our community is reflected in the depth of faculty, academic, research, professional, personal, and social support services that HMS offers.

medSchoolCurriculum.instructionStyle: The Pathways Curriculum incorporates pedagogical approaches that foster active learning and critical thinking; earlier clinical experience; and advanced clinical and student-tailored basic/population
medSchoolCurriculum.clinicalRotations: For Pathways students, the Principal Clinical Experience (PCE) begins in January of Year II.  HST students begin PCE in April of Year II.
medSchoolCurriculum.lectureAttendance: HMS requires attendance and active participation in all components of the curriculum.
medSchoolCurriculum.curricularHighlights: The Pathways Program is a case-based curriculum that emphasizes small-group work and self-directed learning, complemented by laboratories and lectures. The Pathways Program enrolls 135 students each year. A second M.D. curricular track is the Harvard-M.I.T. Division of Health Sciences and Technology Program (HST).  This collaboration between the Harvard Medical School and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology is designed for students with a strong interest and background in quantitative science. Courses in the first two years are taught at both HMS and MIT by faculty drawn from both institutions. HST enrolls 30 students per year. Both Programs participate in a Principal Clinical Experience rotating through the departments in a large affiliated teaching hospital, followed by clerkships in other affiliated institutions. Basic science and clinical content are interwoven throughout the four years in both programs.

medSchoolInformation.generalInformation: A leader in medical education since its inception in 1782, Harvard Medical School forms the center of one of the nation's premier locations for medical training, research and practice.  The school is affiliated with a number of different hospitals and clinical sites, has seven basic and two social science departments and over 12,000 affiliated faculty, including more than 5,000 full and part-time faculty instructors.

medSchoolFinancial.financialAid: HMS is deeply committed to helping students manage the expense of medical school and has one of the most generous MD financial aid programs in the country.  Each year, HMS awards millions of dollars in need-based institutional scholarship funds to qualifying students. In academic year 2025-26, over $44 million in scholarship and loan funding from various federal and private sources was administered to 71% of the student body. As a result of our generous financial aid programs, HMS maintains an average graduating debt well below the national average. HMS also offers a loan forgiveness program for graduates who pursue careers in medical fields where starting salaries may be lower than average.

medSchoolSelection.selectionFactors: Academic excellence is expected. Committee members consider the entire application, including the essay, extracurricular activities, life experiences, research, community work, and the comments contained in letters of recommendation. Harvard Medical School looks for evidence of integrity, maturity, humanitarian concerns, leadership potential, and an aptitude for working with people. The 2025 entering class came from 62 different undergraduate institutions, including representatives from 31 U.S. States and citizens of 9 other countries. Harvard Medical School does not accept applications for advanced standing or transfer.
